text: The Go acceptance adapter selects one exact test under the part's captured test_one command (#527). It accepts only direct go test argument arrays with exactly one {test} placeholder as the value of -run, narrows a provably inclusive local package scope such as ./... to the acceptance file's package, keeps the rest of the command's policy, and escapes and anchors each selector component with Go's regexp rules; wrappers, shell templates, conflicting or repeated selection flags and opaque forms are refused before preparation. Discovery in the prepared offline environment confirms the pinned file's bytes and inclusion, exactly one valid top-level testing declaration across ordinary and external test packages, and the actual import path, compiling without running initialization or tests. It establishes which test may run, never that one completed: runtime evidence and compiler-failure attribution come in #523's next issues, and no adapter is enabled by default.
